# Random Canvas Game Idea

**Title:** Gravity Flip Runner
**Concept:** An endless runner where the player controls a square that constantly moves right. Tapping the screen flips gravity, moving the square between the floor and ceiling to dodge incoming spikes.
**Lose Condition:** The square collides with a spike or falls off the canvas.

1: // Gravity Flip Runner – minimal canvas game
2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if (!canvas) return;
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const W = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800;
7:   const H = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 200;
8: 
9:   // player
10:   const player = {x: 50, size: 20, y: H - 20, vy: 0, gravity: 0.6, onGround: true, dir: -1}; // dir -1 = floor, 1 = ceiling
11: 
12:   // obstacles (spikes)
13:   const spikes = [];
14:   // utility to draw rounded rectangles
15:   function drawRoundedRect(x,y,w,h,radius,fillStyle){
16:     ctx.beginPath();
17:     ctx.moveTo(x+radius, y);
18:     ctx.lineTo(x+w-radius, y);
19:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x+w, y, x+w, y+radius);
20:     ctx.lineTo(x+w, y+h-radius);
21:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x+w, y+h, x+w-radius, y+h);
22:     ctx.lineTo(x+radius, y+h);
23:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y+h, x, y+h-radius);
24:     ctx.lineTo(x, y+radius);
25:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x+radius, y);
26:     ctx.closePath();
27:     ctx.fillStyle = fillStyle;
28:     ctx.fill();
29:   }
30:   let spawnTimer = 0;
31:   const SPAWN_INTERVAL = 1200; // ms
32:   let lastTime = 0;
33:   let running = true;
34: 
35:   // flip gravity on tap/click
36:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
37:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
38:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
39:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
40:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
41:     osc.type = 'sine';
42:     osc.connect(gain);
43:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
44:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
45:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
46:     osc.start();
47:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration / 1000);
48:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration / 1000);
49:   }
50:   // helper to ensure AudioContext is resumed before playing
51:   function safePlay(freq, duration) {
52:     audioCtx.resume().then(() => playTone(freq, duration));
53:   }
54:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
55:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
56:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
57:     osc.type = 'sine';
58:     osc.connect(gain);
59:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
60:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
61:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
62:     osc.start();
63:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration / 1000);
64:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration / 1000);
65:   }
66:   canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', () => {
67:     // ensure audio context is running
68:     audioCtx.resume().then(() => {
69:       playTone(440, 200);
70:     });
71:     player.dir *= -1; // swap floor/ceiling
72:     player.vy = 0;
73:     player.onGround = false;
74:   });
75: 
76:   function spawnSpike() {
77:     const size = 20;
78:     const y = player.dir === -1 ? H - size : 0; // attach to floor/ceiling
79:     spikes.push({x: W, y, size});
80:   }
81: 
82:   function update(dt) {
83:     // player vertical motion
84:     if (!player.onGround) {
85:       player.vy += player.gravity * player.dir * dt / 16;
86:       player.y += player.vy;
87:     }
88:     // clamp to floor/ceiling
89:     if (player.dir === -1 && player.y >= H - player.size) {
90:       player.y = H - player.size; player.vy = 0; player.onGround = true;
91:     } else if (player.dir === 1 && player.y <= 0) {
92:       player.y = 0; player.vy = 0; player.onGround = true;
93:     }
94: 
95:     // move spikes
96:     for (let i = spikes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
97:       spikes[i].x -= 2; // constant speed
98:       // collision detection (simple AABB)
99: if (
100:           player.x < spikes[i].x + spikes[i].size &&
101:           player.x + player.size > spikes[i].x &&
102:           player.y < spikes[i].y + spikes[i].size &&
103:           player.y + player.size > spikes[i].y
104:         ) {
105:           // play collision sound then end game
106:           safePlay(220, 300);
107:           running = false; // lose
108:         }
109:       // remove off‑screen
110:       if (spikes[i].x + spikes[i].size < 0) spikes.splice(i, 1);
111:     }
112: 
113:     // spawn logic
114:     spawnTimer += dt;
115:     if (spawnTimer > SPAWN_INTERVAL) {
116:       spawnSpike();
117:       spawnTimer = 0;
118:     }
119:   }
120: 
121:   function draw() {
122:     // background gradient
123:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
124:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
125:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#003');
126:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
127:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
128:     // score display
129:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
130:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
131:     ctx.textAlign = 'left';
132:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(lastTime / 1000), 10, 20);
133:     // player
134:     // draw rounded player
135:     drawRoundedRect(player.x, player.y, player.size, player.size, 4, '#09f');
136:     // spikes
137:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f44';
138:     spikes.forEach(s => {
139:       ctx.beginPath();
140:       if (player.dir === -1) {
141:         // floor spike – triangle pointing up
142:         ctx.moveTo(s.x, s.y + s.size);
143:         ctx.lineTo(s.x + s.size / 2, s.y);
144:         ctx.lineTo(s.x + s.size, s.y + s.size);
145:       } else {
146:         // ceiling spike – triangle pointing down
147:         ctx.moveTo(s.x, s.y);
148:         ctx.lineTo(s.x + s.size / 2, s.y + s.size);
149:         ctx.lineTo(s.x + s.size, s.y);
150:       }
151:       ctx.closePath();
152:       ctx.fill();
153:     });
154:     // game over overlay
155:     if (!running) {
156:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
157:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
158:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
159:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
160:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
161:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2, H / 2);
162:     }
163:   }
164: 
165:   function loop(timestamp) {
166:     if (!lastTime) lastTime = timestamp;
167:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
168:     lastTime = timestamp;
169:     if (running) update(dt);
170:     draw();
171:     if (running) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
172:   }
173:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
174: })();
